033public class SecurityCodes extends HubMissionWithBarEvent implements ColonyPlayerHostileActListener,
034                                                                                                                                 MarineLossesStatModifier {
035
036        public static enum Stage {
037                ACTIVE,
038                COMPLETED,
039        }
040        
041        public static float MARINE_LOSSES_MULT = 0.05f;
042        
043        public static float PROB_COMPLICATIONS = 0.5f;
044        public static float PROB_PATROL_ENCOUNTER_AFTER = 0.5f;
045        
046        public static float MIN_DAYS = 120f;
047        public static float MAX_DAYS = 180f;
048        
049        public static float BASE_PRICE = 30000;
050        
051        protected int price;
052        protected FactionAPI faction;
053        protected int days;
054        
055        
056        @Override
057        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
058                if (barEvent) {
059                        setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
060                        setGiverPost(pickOne(Ranks.POST_AGENT, Ranks.POST_SMUGGLER, Ranks.POST_GANGSTER, 
061                                                                 Ranks.POST_FENCE, Ranks.POST_CRIMINAL));
062                        setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
063                        setGiverFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
064                        setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
065                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
066                }
067                
068                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
069                if (person == null) return false;
070                
071                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$seco_ref")) {
072                        return false;
073                }
074                
075                requireMarketFactionNotPlayer();
076                requireMarketFactionCustom(ReqMode.NOT_ANY, Factions.CUSTOM_DECENTRALIZED);
077                requireMarketNotHidden();
078                requireMarketNotInHyperspace();
079                
080                MarketAPI market = pickMarket();
081                if (market == null) return false;
082                
083                faction = market.getFaction();
084                if (faction == null) return false;
085                if (!setFactionMissionRef(faction, "$seco_ref")) {
086                        return false;
087                }
088                
089                price = getRoundNumber((BASE_PRICE * (getQuality() + 0.9f + 0.2f * genRandom.nextFloat())) / getRewardMult());
090                
091                setStartingStage(Stage.ACTIVE);
092                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
093                
094                setNoAbandon();
095                setRepPersonChangesVeryLow();
096                setRepFactionChangesTiny();
097                
098                days = (int)Math.round(MIN_DAYS + (MAX_DAYS - MIN_DAYS) * getQuality());
099                setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, faction, "$seco_completed");
100                setTimeLimit(Stage.COMPLETED, days, null);
101                
102                if (rollProbability(PROB_COMPLICATIONS)) {
103                        triggerComplicationBegin(Stage.ACTIVE, ComplicationSpawn.EXITING_SYSTEM,
104                                        createdAt.getStarSystem(), Factions.PIRATES,
105                                        "the security codes", "they", "the " + faction.getPersonNamePrefix() + " security codes",
106                                        0,
107                                        true, ComplicationRepImpact.NONE, null);
108                        triggerComplicationEnd(true);
109                }
110                
111                //addTempIntel();
112                return true;
113        }
114        
115        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
116                set("$seco_barEvent", isBarEvent());
117                set("$seco_price", Misc.getWithDGS(price));
118                set("$seco_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
119                set("$seco_hisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer());
120                set("$seco_heOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe());
121                set("$seco_days", days);
122                set("$seco_faction", faction.getPersonNamePrefix());
123                set("$seco_factionColor", faction.getBaseUIColor());
124        }
125        
126        @Override
127        public void addDescriptionForCurrentStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
128                float opad = 10f;
129                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
130                if (currentStage == Stage.ACTIVE) {
131                        FactionAPI f = faction;
132                        String percent = "" + (int) Math.round((1f - MARINE_LOSSES_MULT) * 100f) + "%";
133                        LabelAPI label = info.addPara("You've acquired ground-forces security codes for %s." + 
134                                        " Having these allows for much better raid planning " +
135                                                        "and will reduce marine casualties by %s.",
136                                        opad, f.getBaseUIColor(),
137                                        f.getDisplayNameWithArticle(), percent);
138                        label.setHighlight(f.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle(), percent);
139                        label.setHighlightColors(f.getBaseUIColor(), h);
140                        
141                        info.addPara("The codes are only good for one operation, and, if not used, " +
142                                                 "will also expire after a time.", opad);
143                }
144        }
145
146        @Override
147        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
148                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
149                if (currentStage == Stage.ACTIVE) {
150//                      info.addPara("Have security codes for " + faction.getDisplayName(), tc, pad);
151//                      return true;
152                }
153                return false;
154        }       
155
156        @Override
157        public void acceptImpl(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
158                super.acceptImpl(dialog, memoryMap);
159                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
160        }
161
162        @Override
163        protected void notifyEnding() {
164                super.notifyEnding();
165                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
166        }
167        
168        @Override
169        public String getBaseName() {
170                return "Security Codes - " + faction.getDisplayName();
171        }
172        
173        public String getPostfixForState() {
174                if (isEnding()) {
175                        return " (Expired)";    
176                }
177                return "";
178        }
179        
180        @Override
181        protected String getMissionTypeNoun() {
182                return "Information";
183        }
184        
185        @Override
186        protected String getToCompleteText() {
187                return "remaining";
188        }
189        
190        
191        protected void checkCodesUsed(MarketAPI market) {
192                if (market != null && market.getFaction() == faction) {
193                        if (!isEnded() || isEnding()) {
194                                if (rollProbability(PROB_PATROL_ENCOUNTER_AFTER)) {
195                                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(genRandom, getMissionId());
196                                        e.setDelayShort();
197                                        e.setLocationCoreOnly(true, faction.getId());
198                                        e.beginCreate();
199                                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, faction.getId(), FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, new Vector2f());
200                                        e.triggerSetAdjustStrengthBasedOnQuality(true, getQuality());
201                                        e.triggerSetPatrol();
202                                        e.triggerSetStandardAggroInterceptFlags();
203                                        e.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue("$seco_marketName", market.getName());
204                                        e.triggerSetFleetGenericHailPermanent("SECOPatrolHail");
205                                        e.endCreate();
206                                }
207                        }
208                        Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
209                        endAfterDelay();
210                }
211        }
212        public void reportRaidToDisruptFinished(InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
213                        MarketAPI market, TempData actionData, Industry industry) {
214                checkCodesUsed(market);
215        }
216
217        public void reportRaidForValuablesFinishedBeforeCargoShown(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, 
218                        MarketAPI market, TempData actionData,
219                        CargoAPI cargo) {
220                checkCodesUsed(market);
221        }
222
223        public void reportSaturationBombardmentFinished(
224                        InteractionDialogAPI dialog, MarketAPI market, TempData actionData) {
225        }
226
227        public void reportTacticalBombardmentFinished(InteractionDialogAPI dialog,
228                        MarketAPI market, TempData actionData) {
229        }
230
231        public void modifyMarineLossesStatPreRaid(MarketAPI market, List<GroundRaidObjectivePlugin> objectives, MutableStat stat) {
232                if (market != null && market.getFaction() == faction) {
233                        stat.modifyMult("seco_mult", MARINE_LOSSES_MULT, "Security codes");
234                }
235        }
236}
